rules.rule: When implementing a class where methods depend on internal state initialized in `__init__`, verify that all instance attributes accessed by other methods are guaranteed to be assigned during initialization or lazy-initialization, because accessing uninitialized attributes leads to runtime errors when method contracts are violated or order of execution varies.
